entry=$(grep -E "id:[[:space:]]*$P[[:space:]]*[,}]" "$B/spaces.yaml" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

access=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | sed -n 's/.*access:[[:space:]]*\([a-z]*\).*/\1/p')
if [ -n "$path" ] && git config -f "$B/.gitmodules" --get-regexp '^submodule\..*\.path$' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | grep -qxF "$path"; then echo "MOUNTED $P $path ${access:-?}"; else echo "NOT MOUNTED $P"; fi; ls "$B/$path/.git" 2>&1 | head -2
